description: What the window is allowed to ask the Rust side for. Commands defined by this application are permitted by being defined; the core plugins are not, and listening for events is one of them -- without this the streaming half is denied, and the only place that is said is the webview's own console. Opening a link is allowed for web and mail addresses only, so a link in a ticket cannot ask the system to open a file or run a handler. The clipboard is text only, for the terminal's copy and paste.
